description: Run the full ASC 606 five-step recognition for a general revenue contract: identify the performance obligations (Step 2), allocate the transaction price by standalone selling price (Step 4), and recognize over time or at a point in time (Step 5). Give the transaction price and the promised items (each with its standalone selling price). Whatever the engine can't determine from what you provide — distinctness, timing — it logs as an OPEN ITEM rather than guessing. The result is recorded on the engagement file; a principal signs before the workpapers are delivered.

engagement_id.description: The revenue-contract engagement (opened + classified as a general revenue contract).

items.description: The promised items in the contract.

id.description: A short id for the promised item.

separately_usable.description: Can the customer benefit from it on its own? Omit if unknown and it becomes an open item.

ssp_usd.description: The standalone selling price of this item, if known.

name: compute_revenue_contract
